lyrics:
[Intro: plucked guitar figure, soft kick, distant surf]

[Verse 1: breathy female voice, close]
I had a book, I had a plan
A week of nothing, no demands
Then you sat down, then you said hi
I felt the whole plan wave goodbye

[Chorus: deep bass in, voice doubled]
This is not what I came for
This is not on the list
I came here to be quiet
Not to be noticing this
Not what I came for
Don't sit there

[Verse 2: voice a little warmer]
You ask the waiter for his name
You laugh too loud, it's all the same
I've read this line eleven times
You're not my type. That's my best lie.

[Chorus: deep bass, voice doubled]
This is not what I came for
This is not on the list
I came here to be quiet
Not to be noticing this
Not what I came for
Don't sit there

[Break: guitar alone, whispered]
Okay. Sit there.

[Outro: guitar and beat, a page turned, a laugh]
